focus: D2 Security - trust boundary, rehomed env defaults, and transport names on the callers (launcher, plugin, Pi docs, runtime caller-context)

findingDetails.title: Launcher reports having built an MCP server, and its comments still name an MCP child under the deleted path
findingDetails.evidence: actions.push('installed dependencies and built @spec-kit/system-skill-advisor MCP server') is operator-visible output from the artifact bootstrap; :39 says 'before spawning the MCP child'; :1227 names 'the real mcp-server'.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reword the action string to describe the daemon/supervisor role and update the two comments to runtime/.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Traced the actions array to its print path, confirmed the line is outside the vitest guard, and verified the rehomed env defaults at :84-85 so the defect is reporting-only.

findingDetails.title: Pi sync table and extension map describe a caller that no longer exists
findingDetails.evidence: .pi/SYNC.md:29 claims .pi/mcp.json registers system_skill_advisor and code_mode; grepping all five runtime configs returns zero advisor hits. .pi/extensions/README.md:70 documents the adapter importing system-skill-advisor/mcp-server/dist/hooks/claude/user-prompt-submit.js while .pi/extensions/prompt-advisor.ts:52-53 imports runtime/dist/...
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the SYNC.md row and the extension map to the runtime/ path and the no-registration contract.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Grepped every runtime config for an advisor declaration (exit 1) and read the adapter source to establish the real import path; phase 007 had already recorded .pi docs as a known-stale carry-over with no owner.

findingDetails.title: Caller-context module still names the retired MCP transport
findingDetails.evidence: Module header reads 'Advisor MCP Caller Context', the exported type is MCPCallerContext (:7), and the missing-context error says 'MCP caller context missing' (:29); consumers at lib/auth/trusted-caller.ts:5,15,21.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename to a transport-neutral caller-context identifier and update the three consumers plus tests.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Verified the type is constructed by the daemon socket dispatcher rather than an MCP handler (advisor-server.ts runWithCallerContext), so no transport remains to justify the name.

findingDetails.title: Plugin status output and timeout env still speak the deleted bridge
findingDetails.evidence: Status line emits last_bridge_status= and bridge_timeout_ms= (:1456-1458); the tuning env SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS is read at :374 and appears in no live document (only code and tests); DEFAULT_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS at :41.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename the status fields and the env, or document the env as the plugin's advisor-call timeout with its current name and a compatibility alias.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Repo-wide grep for the env and status field names: hits are confined to the plugin, its tests and the plugin test suite; no live doc publishes the knob.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Trust boundary and caller surfaces of a decommissioned transport.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The trust guard and the degraded-answer path are the two security-relevant seams the decommission rewired; the launcher now owns the env the deleted config blocks carried.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Removing MCP left a trust path that no longer authenticates callers

searchActions.result: guard accepts only callerContext.trusted === true and returns a typed UNTRUSTED_CALLER rejection otherwise
trust resolved from the daemon's own environment only; no MCP metadata consulted

searchLedger.rationale: Fails closed on a caller-context flag the daemon alone controls.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No transport-coupled trust input survives the removal.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Deleting the five config env blocks silently dropped a default the daemon still needs

searchActions.result: both defaults supplied by the launcher at :84-85

searchLedger.rationale: Both rehomed defaults are present in the launcher, matching the packet's claim.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Env rehoming verified from the final state.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The launcher still reports MCP-era behavior to operators

searchActions.result: three hits: comment :39, comment :1227, action string :1235

searchLedger.rationale: Operator-visible output asserts a build product that no longer exists.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Pi docs still describe the removed registration and the pre-rename import

searchActions.result: SYNC.md:29 registration claim; extensions/README.md:25,46,70 mcp-server import path
zero hits - the SYNC.md claim is disproved by the configs themselves

searchLedger.rationale: Live maintenance contract contradicted by the tree it describes.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Transport names survive in runtime identifiers
searchLedger.rationale: Name outlives the transport that justified it; raised as a defect per the phase-007 decision to keep code identifiers.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The brief may not arrive when the daemon is cold or unreachable

searchActions.result: primary path calls the CLI without a warm-only marker, so the CLI may start the daemon
degraded local-scorer answers are classified stale, not unavailable, so the brief still renders

searchLedger.rationale: Static trace passes in all three states, but the brief explicitly asks for the three states to be verified; the execution check belongs to the closeout phase and is carried to Deferred Items.
searchLedger.deferredReason: Runtime execution is outside this lineage's write containment; static evidence recorded, execution owed by phase 008.

results.summary: Two packet claims verified true (env rehoming, callers repointed); the no-residue claim still fails on launcher output and Pi docs.
No checklist.md in the target packet; nothing to verify.
